rv.q: I plan to see RICHARD III again, maybe at one of the special performances – it's two and a half hours (including intermission) very well spent!
It's a production that, despite some problems, still makes Shakespeare's sixteenth century drama feel contemporary and accessible.
There is plenty of RICHARD III to enjoy. Coste definitely puts his own spin on a classic.
Seeing her in this role is marvelous! She beautifully and convincingly plays the role of a cutthroat, vile, yet silver-throated, aspirant to the throne.
